mapper.sql: config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue, value_type AS valueType, config_group AS configGroup, secret, description, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform_runtime_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_runtime_config (config_key, config_value, value_type, config_group, secret, description, updated_by, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{valueType}, #{configGroup}, #{secret}, #{description}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), value_type = VALUES(value_type), config_group = VALUES(config_group), secret = VALUES(secret), description = VALUES(description), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at), version = version + 1
